package io.github.dsheirer.vector.calibrate;

/** Test stub: always selects the scalar implementation so the Java oracle is deterministic. */
public class CalibrationManager {
    private static final CalibrationManager INSTANCE = new CalibrationManager();
    public static CalibrationManager getInstance() { return INSTANCE; }
    public Implementation getImplementation(CalibrationType type) { return Implementation.SCALAR; }
    public Implementation getUncalibrated() { return Implementation.SCALAR; }
}
